notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40973083/a4cb73eb2c60122abac16713c4b28c01a0daed8f.jpg[/img]

A demo version of Christine is available during the Steam Next Fest (21 to 28/Feb), a special event on Steam showcasing game demos. It is an introduction to the game that is still under development.
Christine is an interactive story about the defining year of a girl pursuing her dreams.

We'd like to give people the opportunity to know more about them and share their feedback. The demo will be available just until the end of the event (28/Feb 10 am PST).

Watch a stream where we talk about how the idea of the game started, how it is being created, and what's coming next. 
On 26/Feb at 3 pm PST (click [url=https://www.timeanddate.com/worldclock/fixedtime.html?msg=Christine+Making-of+and+Chat+with+the+Devs&iso=20220226T15&p1=137&ah=2]here[/url] to convert to your timezone), you can talk with the devs in the chat. We'll answer questions and get feedback from players!

Play the demo, give us your feedback in the Community Hub. 
Add the game to your wishlist to be notified about the evolution and the full release.

notes.title: Happy 2022! See our next games
notes.content:
[b]Happy 2022 to our friends![/b] We wish you a year full of moments of joy and peace!

We're excited to tell you about some of our releases for the year.

[h1]Little Inner Monsters[/h1]
[b]Little Inner Monsters[/b] is the closest to release. It's a card game about emotions and feelings that you can play against a friend or against the computer.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35765065/76273931635d8b0811b5350480359b42c425550c.png[/img]

The Steam page is active and you can add it to a wish list and follow it for updates.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1813190/Little_Inner_Monsters__Card_Game/?utm_source=steamnews&utm_campaign=ms_page


[h1]Christine[/h1]
[b]Christine[/b] is an interactive story about a young orphan working at the Paris Opera, with an untapped talent for singing. This game will take longer to be released, but we're working hard on it and hope you like it.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35765065/034b846e870289df118b9d991d0c7363004f4dc4.png[/img]

The Steam page is also live!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1691500/Christine/?utm_source=steamnews&utm_campaign=ms_page

Both projects are being carried out in partnership with our friends Katia Numakura, producing the illustrations, and Tatyana Jacques, creating the music and sound design.
In addition to working with us on many games, they also have other amazing creations. Follow them on Instagram:

notes.title: Saying Hello to Christine!
notes.content:
Hi! We at Mens Sana Interactive are developing a story-based game called Christine.

We admire the story of Phantom of the Opera, both the book by Gaston Leroux and the musical by Andrew Lloyd Weber. It allows for many reflections, which may suggest anything from a love triangle to classic myths about human nature. The heroine of the story, Christine, faces deep conflicts that define her destiny.

That motivated us to create a story inspired by elements of that character's life, in a nowadays context: 
Christine is a young orphan who works at the Paris Opera, with an unexplored talent for singing. 
Is it worth facing her fears to pursue her goal?

This indie game is an interactive story with a unique musical score, where you will follow the defining year in Christine's quest for her dreams.

It is a work in progress and there is still a lot to be developed. But the team is passionate about the project and wishes to share its progress here at the Community Hub. Your feedback will be greatly appreciated.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40973083/865747efe3ce3c5d0b260ff36e1c2c6f70b3b066.png[/img]

We are happy to count on the partnership of good friends: 

The screenplay is being written by Noemi Hirokado and Katia Numakura.

The art is being created by Katia Numakura, who has worked with us in previous games. Follow her on Instagram: [url=https://instagram.com/katia.numakura?utm_medium=chris_steam]@katia.numakura[/url].

The music and sound design will be created by Tatyana Jacques, who is also a partner in our games. Follow her on Instagram:[url=https://instagram.com/taty_jacques?utm_medium=chris_steam]@taty_jacques[/url].

Don’t forget to wishlist Christine and follow it on the store page. You will be notified of the updates on the game development progress.
